From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft offer: Samantha Jones — Staff Backend Engineer

Laura — thanks for the draft. A few asks from my side before we send: 

1) Competitive counter: candidate mentioned another in-market offer. Can we increase sign-on to $25k? If not, I want to propose a $10k cash + accelerated equity tranche (see 3).
2) Base: I'm open to $200k if comp can approve; this person is senior IC and will be expected to lead a service migration in Q1.
3) Equity: bump to 0.35% total or adjust vesting to include a 12-month accelerated grant (25% at 6 months) to help retention.
4) Probation clause: 90-day probation language feels punitive and may deter; suggest replacing with a 60-day performance review with explicit manager check-ins.
5) Start flexibility: candidate may need remote overlap week due to relocation; confirm we can allow partial remote first week.

Also please ask Legal to review the non-compete/garden-leave phrasing in section 7 — candidate is currently in EMEA on a contractor arrangement and we should avoid overbroad language.

If comp constraints mean we can't meet cash requests, let's prepare an escalation path (Director signoff / approval matrix). I can loop in my director if needed.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Engineering Manager, Backend
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Hey team — quick comp rundown from People Ops: 

- L5 band at Marcus's org: $170k-$200k (midpoint $185k). Base at $200k is at the absolute top of the band and will require justification for market uplift; Director signoff will be needed.
- Signing bonus: up to $20k is approvable via standard comp committee if the manager documents counteroffer risk and retention plan. $25k would require VP approval, which can be time-consuming and may slow the offer.
- Equity: moving from 0.25% to 0.35% is feasible but would push us into an approval bucket requiring stock committee PM notification; quicker path is to keep equity and add a 6-month retention tranche (0.05%) as a discretionary grant.
- Probation: we discourage language that implies dismissal within a fixed window; recommend the 60-day review language Marcus suggested. Legal prefers '90-day introductory period' replaced with 'first 90 days focused on onboarding with scheduled performance checkpoints' — but I'm flexible to combine with a 60-day manager review.

Actionables: 
- If Marcus ok with $20k sign-on and a 6mo retention tranche, I can get comp committee approval within 48 hours.
- If Marcus insists on $25k or $200k base we will need Director/VP approvals (timeline +3 business days).

I've uploaded the comp justification template to the drive (link below) — please use it if you want expedited approval.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/comp_approvals/OPP-7892

-Mina
Mina Haddad
People Ops — Total Rewards
mina_haddad@redwood.com

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for your time with the team. Per internal alignment (summary below), wed like to present an updated offer for your review. This still leaves some items pending approval but we wanted to give you the clearest picture up front.

Offer summary (updated):
- Base salary: $195,000
- Sign-on bonus: $20,000 (one-time) — payable first payroll after start
- Equity: 0.25% RSU, 4-year vest (1yr cliff) + 0.05% discretionary retention tranche at 6 months
- Start window: Target Aug 2, 2026. We can accommodate a phased remote-first week for relocation needs.
- Performance checkpoints: 60-day manager review + ongoing 1:1s; standard onboarding plan provided.
- Contingencies: Offer contingent on successful background check and completion of right-to-work verification; I-9 to be completed on or before start date for US hires.
- Sign deadline: 7 business days from receipt of DocuSign.

We are attaching the revised offer PDF for your review (Offer_Draft_Samantha_Jones_v1.pdf, redlines included). Please let us know any questions — if youre comfortable we will send via DocuSign once comp confirms sign-on and retention tranche approvals (expected by EOD tomorrow).

On legal items you asked about: relocation assistance is limited to up to $5,000 reimbursement upon submission of receipts unless otherwise escalated. Non-compete language has been softened to a standard confidentiality and limited non-solicit clause only.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Talent Acquisition | Redwood Inference
